description:
Read and edit single elements on a saved page, or append a section. Pick the operation with `action` and pass that action's arguments (help:true returns its full documentation and schema).
- search_page_elements: Search/filter elements within a page source.
- get_page_element: Get full detail of a single element by its ID (e.g.
- update_page_element: Update properties of a specific element in page source.
- update_page_elements: Batch update multiple elements in one page.
- add_section: Append a section to an EXISTING page's source.

config.description: Config to merge (layout: widthUnit auto|px|%, constraintX/Y, columnStart…). [update_page_element]

dry_run.description: Preview only (true) or apply changes (false). [update_page_element, update_page_elements, add_section]

has_events.description: Only elements with events (click, submit, mouseenter, etc.) [search_page_elements]
